notes.title: 📣 Reality Breach – Store Update & Demo 2.0 Incoming 📣
notes.notes:
Hey folks! 👋
It’s been a long while since my last update. I’ve been fully focused on delivering this project to you.

It’s now been a year since I introduced Reality Breach to Steam. Since then, I’ve been working full-time every single day to bring the vision in my head to life. The road has been bumpy, with plenty of obstacles along the way. As this is my first commercial project and my first serious attempt at making a game solo, I’ve made mistakes, learned lessons, and had to rethink strategies more than once.

But here’s the good news: Reality Breach is finally nearing the end of development!
🔑 Key Updates
Store Page Refreshed 😱 → New screenshots, new art, and an updated description that better represents the current game.

Demo 1 has been buried 🪦 → Making way for Demo 2.0 – The Rebirth, with polished visuals, smoother gameplay, and clearer storytelling.

Demo 2.0 is coming soon! 🔨 → You’ll get the chance to try it before release.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120774/df946c160c3200ec7230a09b80177369ddef60ff.png"]
👁️What’s Next
Reality Breach is in its final stretch. Content is done — now I’m polishing, fixing bugs, and making sure everything feels right. My goal is to deliver it before 2026, and if there are any delays, I’ll be transparent and keep you informed.



Your wishlists and support mean everything to me.
Stay tuned! The end is nigh!



TheBossa Works

notes.title: 📢 Devlog Update: Reality Breach Progress Report #3
notes.notes:
Hello, Reality Breachers!

It’s been a few weeks since the last update, and I wanted to catch you up on all the exciting progress with Reality Breach.

The past few weeks have been all about AI development—and let me tell you, it’s been a challenge! But I’m thrilled to share that the AI system is now up and running. It’s currently undergoing playtesting to iron out bugs and ensure it feels just right. While that’s in progress, I’ve shifted my focus back to level design, crafting unique and immersive locations that reward exploration and unravel the deeper mysteries of the game.

The story is really starting to take shape. It’s becoming darker, more personal, and full of twists that will keep you guessing. Each step forward brings new layers to uncover, and I can’t wait for you to piece it all together.

I’m currently putting the finishing touches on Theo’s apartment, making it more interactive and transforming it into a completely fresh experience. If you’ve played the demo, you’ll notice some big changes—expect a space that’s more engaging, full of intrigue, and packed with surprises.

What’s Next for Reality Breach?

Right now, I’m focused on wrapping up Theo’s apartment and the first floor of the complex, making sure these areas are full of mysteries to uncover and secrets to find. At the same time, the AI system is undergoing rigorous testing to ensure everything works seamlessly.

Once these pieces are polished, the next step is releasing an updated demo with all the new changes. Your feedback will be crucial for shaping the final version of the game. From there, I’ll be fine-tuning the overall game systems and bringing everything together for the full release.

Step by step, Reality Breach is coming to life. Thank you for being part of this journey—I can’t wait to share what’s next and thank you for your continuous support and patience!

notes.title: 📢 Devlog Update: Reality Breach Progress Report #2
notes.notes:
Hello, Reality Breachers! 👾

Development on Reality Breach is progressing well, with this week’s goal focused on bringing the AI closer to its full potential! My current priority is building an intelligent AI that truly challenges players—both in strategy and atmosphere.

Creating AI that responds smartly in real-time can be tricky. While I’m crafting this AI, I’m also tackling bugs along the way, ensuring a stable experience for you. At this stage, the AI can patrol, chase, attack, and determine if a player is hidden, but there’s still more ground to cover.

Here's what I’m working on:

Environmental Awareness: The AI is being designed to react to changes in the surroundings. It will recognize when doors are opened, closed, or locked, and it will find alternative routes when needed. Fine-tuning these reactions is ongoing to create a more immersive experience.

Enhanced Animation: The AI needs animations that truly capture its unique personality, making it feel even more alive and engaging.

Bug Fixes & Polish: While the AI's core functions are in place, I’m working through some glitches to ensure smooth performance for the final version.

In Summary:

✅ AI can Idle, Patrol, Chase, and Attack players.
🛠️ Partial environmental interaction is in place (e.g., opening doors and recognizing obstacles), though still undergoing fixes.
🎭 AI animations will soon be tailored to enhance its personality.
🔊 Adding sound effects to further heighten player immersion.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your support as Reality Breach comes to life!

notes.title: 📢 Devlog Update: Reality Breach Progress Report
notes.notes:
Hello, Reality Breachers!

I’m thrilled to share the latest progress on Reality Breach!🚀👾

I'm hard at work on the second demo update, with level design being the current focus. Significant improvements have been made, leading to a dramatic transformation from the existing demo. Expect better graphics, enhanced lighting, more areas to explore, more objects to interact with, and a deeper level of visual storytelling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120774/49c54d8d2ff05e262e67b77f98b9973e14e121d1.jpg

So, what’s new?

Level Design:

Theo's Apartment: The apartment has undergone a major overhaul. While the layout remains familiar, it’s now slightly larger with upgraded assets, furniture, and lighting to enhance the atmosphere.

Apartment Complex: A new addition allows you to exit Theo’s apartment and explore the complex. You’ll uncover more about Theo's surroundings, including diverse lifestyles and unsettling secrets that will keep you on edge.

Basement: A darker, maze-like area is being introduced. Expect a claustrophobic and nerve-wracking experience. Getting in might be easy, but leaving will test your survival instincts.

Airducts: The air ducts provide alternative routes for stealth and traversal, helping you avoid danger. But don’t rely on them too much — sometimes, you’ll have no choice but to take the riskier path.

Streets: Theo’s neighbourhood is eerie and unsettling. While the streets offer a more open environment, they’re no safer than the cramped halls. They’ll connect you deeper into the lore while keeping the tension high.

In summary: The level design is progressing well. The second demo will feature most of these new areas, though not all will be accessible until full release.

Mechanics:

I’ve begun implementing mechanics from the current demo into the new map. These include:

Door and furniture interactions
Inventory system and items
Hiding mechanics
Light system
Airduct crawling system
Puzzle-solving, notes, and more!
You'll find more objects to interact with and a wider variety of puzzles to challenge you.

Enemy AI:

I’m also making progress with the AI. While it wasn't in the current demo due to missing animations, the AI is now in a better state. It can roam, attack, chase, and perform other tasks, creating a more intense and immersive experience. Expect to see the AI in the second demo!

To wrap up: Reality Breach is progressing well, with the second demo on track to bring new areas, enhanced mechanics, and the introduction of AI. If you'd like more sneak peeks or have specific questions, feel free to share them in the discussions!

Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to follow, wishlist, and keep up with the journey! 🎮👾

notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog Update: Sneak Peek of the Updated Map! 🗺️
notes.notes:
Hello, Reality Breachers!

I’m thrilled to give you a sneak peek at some major updates coming to Reality Breach! After carefully reviewing your feedback, I’ve been working hard to upgrade and expand the map with better assets, new areas to explore, and deeper immersion into Theo's unsettling world. These changes will offer more opportunities for tension, stealth, and puzzle-solving.

Here’s a glimpse at the revamped environment! 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120774/036e91333d51ae6f3e5beec30734d14f9b819b4e.jpg

The updated visuals and enhanced assets create a more immersive experience, pulling you further into Theo’s shoes. Rooms have been slightly expanded, offering more space to explore without losing that crucial sense of unease.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120774/2423ba7df710316ecd0cd48dfe6b080901d3cecf.jpg

Originally, the plan was to keep the house small and claustrophobic, amplifying the stress and tension. However, after considering your feedback, I’ve decided to extend the map. Now, you’ll get to explore beyond Theo’s apartment—but don’t get too comfortable. This isn’t a peaceful, open-world escape. 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120774/a5dd3ed2f4b830065ff33ea3cfdea8f945727f79.jpg

With the expanded map, you can expect even more spine-chilling, surreal experiences. The extra space has also allowed me to create more intricate puzzles, adding complexity to your journey. But don’t worry—the environment will provide clear hints and safe spots, along with hiding places to ease your stress as you progress.

Stay tuned, follow Reality Breach, and add it to your wishlist to stay up to date on the latest developments!

Thank you for your continued support.
Happy (and terrifying) gaming!
TheBossa Works
